# Geidl et al. 2015, published EEM parameters

`B3LYP_6-311G_NPA.par` is copied byte for byte from Additional file 2 of `geidl2015`
(doi 10.1186/s13321-015-0107-1; `EEM_parameters/B3LYP_6-311G_NPA.par` inside
`13321_2015_107_MOESM2_ESM.rar`). The article and its files are CC BY 4.0, S. Geidl, T. Bouchal,
T. Raček, R. Svobodová Vařeková, V. Hejret, A. Křenek, R. Abagyan and J. Koča.

SHA-256 `552f9d48b5d5b90c5a70add7e9ee32cf632fce2006265bfcb5056d256f90544e`. Format: `kappa k`, then
`element highest-bond-order A B` per line. Used by part C of
`benchmarks/charges/models/schindler_sqe_preregistration.md`.
